title: Why Cats Are Zen
subtitle: The Secret of Daily Meditation
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Ever wonder why I’m so chill?
Here’s the secret: Cats meditate. All. The. Time.

When I curl up in the sun? Meditation.
When I close my eyes and purr? Meditation.
When I stare at the wall? Also meditation.

Cats live in the moment: we breathe slow and we listen to the world.

That’s all meditation really is: noticing your breath, your body and your thoughts.

Humans think meditation is fancy — pillows, candles, apps.

But you can start small, like a cat:

  1. Find a warm spot.
  2. Close your eyes.
  3. Breathe slow.

Let your mind wander, then come back to now.
Even a few minutes helps your brain calm down.
Be a cat, even if just for five minutes.
